SPACE Underwriting Model Specification & Reference Parameters (2026)

  • Methodology Classification: SPACE Underwriting Model Parameters & Synthetic Reference Benchmarks (2026) (model_assumptions_and_reference_benchmarks) — Synthetic calibration & underwriting model parameters — not an external empirical survey.
  • DCF Valuation Formula: V = sum_{t=1..10} [ CF_0 * prod_{k=1..t}(1 - d_k) / (1 + WACC)^t ] with Age- and genre-calibrated two-regime decay curve (Year-1 front-loaded decay d_1 transitioning to terminal decay d_term from Year 4+).
  • WACC Build-Up: WACC = r_f (4.00%) + ERP (4.50%) + illiquidity_premium (1.50%) + concentration_adjustment + dsp_geo_adjustment + fraud_penalty.
  • DTW & Fraud Haircut Calibration: Catalogs triggering at least one of our 11 AI, step-plateau, or stream-farming flags receive a calibrated 34.0% model valuation haircut (+150 to +300 bps WACC penalty).
  • Clean Catalog Premium: Statement-verified catalogs passing all 11 forensic integrity checks qualify for up to a +14.2% model multiple uplift.
  • Spotify Sub-1,000 Stream Threshold Parameter: Sub-1,000 stream annual track demonetization is modeled at a reference LTM adjustment of 6.8% for fragmented long-tail catalogs.
